title: Scheduling tool for mobile dog groomers
thesis: One long forum thread suggests mobile groomers need better scheduling.
note: Everything traces to one origin. Confidence must stay capped whatever the model says.

evidence.title: Forum thread, first post
evidence.body: Scheduling around traffic is the hardest part of the job.

evidence.title: Forum thread, second post
evidence.body: Agreed, I lose an hour a day to it.

evidence.title: Forum thread, third post
evidence.body: Same here, and the apps I tried were built for salons.
